# MIND Detective 0.3.0 — Offline deterministic execution

`0.3.0` moves deterministic Web/PWA execution to the browser without creating a second hand-maintained domain implementation.

## Highlights

- restricted stdlib-only portable Python kernel is the authoritative executable source;
- a certified generator emits the committed TypeScript executor and source identity metadata;
- committed Python↔TypeScript conformance vectors verify observable parity;
- Case creation and deterministic commands execute locally and persist atomically with execution receipts in IndexedDB;
- retries are idempotent and command-id conflicts fail closed;
- assistant transport failure falls back to the deterministic local proposal without reconnect replay;
- assistant requests carry execution identity and fail closed on version/hash skew;
- the preloaded PWA completes the canonical search workflow offline; service-worker caching remains limited to application shell/static assets;
- Case schema remains `mind-detective-case/v2`; no cloud sync, Pyodide/WASM, Bayesian/POD, calibrated percentages, or hidden belief layer is introduced.

## Release artifacts

- repository tag: `0.3.0`;
- plugin tag: `mind-detective-v0.3.0`;
- publication uses the existing hardened repository-native publisher only after exact post-merge `main` CI and a human-approved full 40-hex target SHA.

Historical `0.1.0` and `0.2.0` release notes and tags remain immutable.
